scenes.headline: How Code2Skill turns GitHub functions into agent skills
scenes.sub: One typed record per function, checked by a blind rebuild
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Loquat! Code to Skill mines GitHub for procedures an agent can reuse.

scenes.text: Describe one function as a typed record, then test the record by asking a model to rebuild the function without seeing it.
scenes.mark: rebuild the function without seeing it
scenes.say: Write each function up as a structured record, then test it by asking a model to rebuild the function without seeing the code.

left.title: A SKILL.md package
left.say: Most agent skills are a folder with a trigger and free-form instructions.

right.title: A Code2Skill record
right.say: This record is narrower: one function's steps, invariants and failure cases, pulled into a reviewer's prompt.

steps.say: Start from every GitHub repository over five hundred stars. A model scores each function for reusable steps.
An extractor writes one typed record: workflow, inputs, invariants, error cases and anti-goals.
Then the round trip. Another call rebuilds the function from the record alone, source hidden.
A judge compares the rebuild with the original. Equivalent means accepted.
If not, an adjudicator decides which one was wrong. Nothing here runs the code.
Accepted records are grouped by purpose into about seven hundred and fifty thousand cards.
The paper draws the same loop, with atomic, composite and pattern skills.
A robot rebuilds the code, a balance weighs it, and accepted cards are deduplicated.

scenes.label: repositories appear in the released bank, at least
scenes.say: Counting the release, at least seven thousand three hundred of the nineteen thousand repositories appear in it.

scenes.title: Seven benchmarks, one loop, average score
scenes.say: At review time the records beat the no-skill loop. The trajectory banks all score below it.

scenes.text: Rebuilding code from its description is a cheap test of completeness. Verified still means two models agreed.
scenes.say: Rebuilding code from its description is a cheap completeness test. But verified still means two models agreed.

recap: One function becomes one typed record
A blind rebuild checks the record is complete
Retrieved at review, skills lift 57 of 72 runs
scenes.say: To recap. One function, one record. A blind rebuild checks it. And at review, the skills lift fifty-seven of seventy-two runs.
